What guests mention most

From the photos, the Instagram profile and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Specialty coffee

5 Google reviews mention the flat white and 4 the specialty coffee. One guest calls the Melbourne style specialty coffee excellent, beautifully made and full of flavour.

Vinyl and music

6 reviews mention the music and 3 the vinyls. One guest writes about specialty coffee, vinyls and small bites, all so good.

Small bites and pastries

3 reviews mention the pastries. The Instagram profile describes Melbourne coffee culture in Paphos with specialty coffee, vinyl and Mediterranean living.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

A place to relax

15 reviews mention the cozy atmosphere. One guest writes that it is a coffee shop where you can truly relax and enjoy, with an originality that most coffee shops lack.

Helpful, attentive staff

One guest writes that the staff were helpful and attentive and the decor excellent. Another writes that the owner took the time to explain the coffee.

Family run

One guest calls it a family run business with a genuine and friendly owner and a hidden gem for specialist coffee.

What guests say

Three of 87 Google reviews, 80 of them with five stars.
